video_title: Thanasis Antetokounmpo REACTS to NBA Superstar LeBron James and the 76ers

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo predicts a trade for the 76ers before December
quotes.excerpt: they're going to make a trade before December

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: The first prediction is they're going to make a trade before December, before January. I can guarantee you they will make a trade. Small, big, they will make a trade.

text_blocks.speaker: Tony Cartagena
text_blocks.text: Okay, before December? I can guarantee you.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo questions how Jaylen Brown can be effective without the ball
quotes.excerpt: How can he be effective if he doesn't have the ball?
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown wants the ball. How can he be effective if he doesn't have the ball? It's a question. He is not a shooter who can work the baseline and get himself open. He is a little bit different. What are you going to ask Jaylen Brown to do? To play like Brook Lopez and defend and just block shots? No, he is one of the most dominant bigs ever. You are going to pass him the ball in the post, play, and go to work.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo emphasizes that Jaylen Brown needs the ball to be effective
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown needs the ball in his hands.
quotes.quote: Last but not least, Jaylen Brown needs the ball in his hands. Now, can he play defense? This is what he is very underrated. People don't know about it. He can play one of the best defenses in the league. He can be one of the best defenders in the league. I have seen it with my own eyes, him playing great defense. In offense, to be effective, he needs the ball.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo clarifies Giannis Antetokounmpo's trade rumors from March
quotes.excerpt: he thought he was going to Cleveland before he got traded to the Heat
quotes.quote: He thought he was going to Cleveland before he got traded to the Heat. This was back in March. Exactly, before he got traded to the Heat.

quotes.speaker: Tony Cartagena
quotes.summary_phrase: Tony Cartagena discusses LeBron James's contract and potential free agency
quotes.excerpt: there is the chance he becomes a free agent next summer, opts out
quotes.quote: I think people are just assuming this is LeBron James's last year, but his contract is a one-and-one with a player option. So, there is the chance he becomes a free agent next summer, opts out, and decides where he wants to go.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the importance of winning championships for legacy
quotes.excerpt: Winning a championship in every franchise you go to is a different game.
quotes.quote: Winning a championship in every franchise you go to is a different game. I don't care what nobody says. I don't want to hear none of that. There is no debate, there is nothing. Bringing a championship to every franchise you go to is different.
